name: Jan Aadhaar
benefit: Free family identity card (10-digit Family ID + 11-digit Member ID) — gateway to 50+ Rajasthan schemes including Chiranjeevi, Ration, Pension, Scholarship, DBT
documents: Aadhaar Card, Family Photo, Mobile Number, Address Proof
apply: janaadhaar.rajasthan.gov.in or SSO Portal or e-Mitra Kiosk

name: RTI Right To Information
benefit: Right to get information from any government department within 30 days. Free for BPL, ₹10 application fee for others
documents: RTI Application (written/online), ID Proof, Application Fee Receipt (₹10)
apply: rtionline.gov.in or nearest Public Information Officer (PIO) office

name: Mukhyamantri Ayushman Arogya Yojana
benefit: ₹25 lakh cashless health insurance + ₹10 lakh accident insurance per family per year at 1,000+ empanelled hospitals. Covers 5 days pre-admission + 15 days post-discharge
documents: Jan Aadhaar Card, Aadhaar Card, Ration Card (BPL), SSO ID
apply: sso.rajasthan.gov.in → Mukhyamantri Ayushman Arogya Yojana or maayojana.rajasthan.gov.in
apply_last_date: No Last Date (Open Year-Round, Annual Renewal Required)

name: Copy of Girdawari
benefit: Free online copy of Girdawari (crop inspection report) — used as proof of farming for bank loans, crop insurance, and government scheme applications
documents: Khasra Number, Khata Number, Village & District details

name: Electrical Inspectorate Department (EID) Rajasthan
benefit: Electrical connection inspection, safety certification (NOC), and approval services for domestic, commercial, and industrial connections
documents: Application Form, Site Plan/Layout, ID Proof, Ownership/Rent Proof, Wiring Completion Certificate
apply: eid.rajasthan.gov.in or nearest Electrical Inspectorate District Office

name: E-Mitra
benefit: One-stop service center for 300+ government services — Bill payment, Certificate apply, Ration Card, Scholarship, Railway tickets (IRCTC), Banking (AEPS), and more at nearest kiosk
documents: Aadhaar Card, Jan Aadhaar Card, relevant documents per service

name: e-Panchayat
benefit: Online tracking of Panchayat development works, budget, Patta details, MLA/MP fund usage, and Rural Development scheme progress in your area

name: Forest Right Act (FRA)
benefit: Legal ownership rights (Patta) over forest land that has been cultivated or lived on for generations. Individual forest rights up to 4 hectares + community forest rights
documents: Aadhaar Card, Proof of forest land occupation (photos, witness statements), Caste Certificate (ST), Revenue records, FRA Claim Form
apply: Gram Sabha → Sub-Divisional Level Committee → District Level Committee | forests.rajasthan.gov.in

name: Jodhpur Vidyut Vitran Nigam Ltd. (JDVVNL)
beneficiary: Electricity consumers in Jodhpur & Western Rajasthan
benefit: New electricity connection, bill payment, complaint registration, meter details, electricity tariff info, and subsidy status for consumers in Jodhpur zone (Jodhpur, Barmer, Jaisalmer, Pali, Sirohi, Bikaner, Churu, etc.)
documents: Aadhaar Card, Address Proof, Property Documents, Application Form
apply: energy.rajasthan.gov.in or jdvvnl.com or nearest JDVVNL Sub-Division Office

name: Labour Card (BOCW — Building & Other Construction Workers)
benefit: Labour Card gives access to 15+ benefits: Daughter marriage grant ₹55,000 | Children scholarship ₹8,000–₹35,000/year | Death benefit ₹5 lakh | Maternity ₹20,000 | Housing loan ₹1.5 lakh | Pension ₹3,000/month | Free Chiranjeevi health cover
documents: Aadhaar Card, Jan Aadhaar Card, 90-day construction work proof (employer certificate), Bank Passbook, Passport Photo
apply: bocw.labour.rajasthan.gov.in or e-Mitra Kiosk | Annual contribution ₹25/year only
apply_last_date: No Last Date (Open Year-Round, Annual Renewal)
